item.title: India Positions AI as Catalyst for Development and Innovation
item.description: India’s AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi highlighted human-centric, globally collaborative AI, promoting innovation, inclusive development, ethical governance and real-world socio-economic applications.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST Partner to Advance Blockchain, AI Innovation
item.description: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Yiyu Network have launched a three-year, HKD 6 million partnership to advance research, innovation and talent development in blockchain and AI.

item.title: Vietnam: Trade Fair Expands Global Technology Partnerships
item.description: Vietnam is using Spring Fair 2026 to expand international partnerships, showcase high-tech capabilities, strengthen regional networks and foster cross-border innovation and collaboration across multiple sectors.

item.title: Singapore: Expanding Community Support for Digital-Age Parents
item.description: Phase 2 of the First Device Campaign has been launched, aiming to strengthen community-based support for parents and help children use technology responsibly and safely in today’s digital age.

item.title: Australia: Empowering Smart Hydrogen Analytics for Southeast Asia
item.description: Australia is collaborating with Laos to build technical and digital capacity in hydrogen system modelling, supporting clean energy planning, industrial decarbonisation, and regional energy innovation.

item.title: Thailand: Using Technology and Data to Restore Coastal Ecosystems
item.description: The five-year, technology-driven collaboration uses digital tools, genomic research and data systems to restore and sustainably manage Thailand’s coastal and marine ecosystems.

item.title: Malaysia: Tech Sectors to Propel 2026 Smart Economic Growth
item.description: Tech-driven sectors, including semiconductors, digital infrastructure, AI and energy transition initiatives, are expected to anchor Malaysia’s 2026 growth, supported by domestic demand and national plans.

item.title: India: Building Employability in an Age of Intelligent Automation
item.description: Experts emphasised that aligning AI with mass employability, continuous upskilling, human-led skills, adaptability, creativity and collaboration is crucial for India’s inclusive, innovation-driven future.

item.title: Hong Kong Fortifies Cybersecurity Training in the AI Era
item.description: Hong Kong is actively enhancing cybersecurity across government and industry by addressing talent gaps, deploying AI-driven threat responses and expanding practical training and governance measures.

item.title: Indonesia and Vietnam Explore Digital Payment Collaboration
item.description: Indonesia and Vietnam are exploring collaboration on digital payment technology to enhance transparency, efficiency and financial inclusion, particularly supporting MSMEs and national economic programmes.
